paragraphs.text: מלי ברכתא די חנוך די ברך לבחירין וזכאין די להון להוון ביום עקתא לאעדיה כל בישין ורשיעין
paragraphs.translit: millē birktāʾ dī Ḥanōk dī bārek lě-bĕḥīrīn wĕ-zakkāʾīn dī lěhōn lěhěwōn bě-yōm ʿāqětāʾ lě-ʾaʿdāyāh kol bīšīn wĕ-rašīʿīn

i18n.en: The words of blessing of Enoch, with which he blessed the elect and the righteous, who shall be living in the day of tribulation, when all the wicked and the godless shall be removed.

paragraphs.text: ונטל מתלה ואמר חנוך גבר זכאי די מן קדם אלהא חזוה אתגלי לה חזוה דקדישא ושמיא די אחזיוני עירין וקדישין כלא ושמעת מנהון כלא ואדעת אנה די חזיתי לא לדרא דנא להן לדרא רחיק די אתה
paragraphs.translit: wĕ-nāṭal mě-talleh wě-ʾămar Ḥanōk gěbar zakkāʾī dī min qŏdām ʾĕlāhāʾ ḥězweh ʾitgĕlī leh, ḥězweh dī qaddīšāʾ wĕ-šĕmayyāʾ dī ʾaḥzěyōnī ʿīrīn wě-qaddīšīn kollāʾ wě-šimʿet minhōn kollāʾ, wě-ʾaddāʿit ʾanāh dī ḥăzēt lāʾ lě-dārāʾ dĕnāʾ lāhēn lě-dārāʾ raḥīq dī ʾāteh

i18n.en: And he took up his parable and said: Enoch, a righteous man, to whom a vision from God was opened, had the vision of the Holy One and of heaven, which the Watchers and the Holy Ones showed me; and from them I heard all things, and I understood what I saw — not for this generation, but for a generation that is far off, that is yet to come.

notes.official: The Aramaic *ʿīrīn wĕ-qaddīšīn* 'Watchers and Holy Ones' is the technical class-pairing of the angelological framework — see central entry `watchers-1-enoch-6-11-bnei-elohim-cross-corpus`. The Watchers' first appearance in the Aramaic Enoch corpus parallels Dan 4:13, 17, 23 (the only HB Aramaic *ʿīr* attestation). The WoH preserves 'Watchers' rather than collapsing to 'angels' (see overlay entry `watchers-english-rendering-convention`).

paragraphs.text: Καὶ περὶ τῶν ἐκλεκτῶν λέγω, καὶ περὶ ἐκείνων ἔλαβον τὴν παραβολήν μου· καὶ ἐξελεύσεται ὁ ἅγιός μου ὁ μέγας ἐκ τῆς κατοικήσεως αὐτοῦ,
paragraphs.translit: Kai peri tōn eklektōn legō, kai peri ekeinōn elabon tēn parabolēn mou; kai exeleusetai ho hagios mou ho megas ek tēs katoikēseōs autou,

i18n.en: Concerning the elect I speak, and concerning them I take up my parable: the Holy Great One will come forth from his dwelling,

notes.official: *ho hagios mou ho megas* 'the Holy Great One' is the apophatic-divine-circumlocution title characteristic of 1 Enoch's apocalyptic register. The title is paired with *hē megalē doxa* 'the Great Glory' at 1 En 14:20 as the corpus's two principal divine-paraphrastic titles. See overlay entry `holy-great-one-great-glory-divine-circumlocution-titles-convention`.

paragraphs.text: καὶ ὁ θεὸς τοῦ αἰῶνος ἐπὶ γῆν πατήσει ἐπὶ τὸ Σινὰ ὄρος, καὶ φανήσεται ἐκ τῆς παρεμβολῆς αὐτοῦ, καὶ φανήσεται ἐν τῇ δυνάμει τῆς ἰσχύος αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: kai ho theos tou aiōnos epi gēn patēsei epi to Sina oros, kai phanēsetai ek tēs parembolēs autou, kai phanēsetai en tē dynamei tēs ischyos autou apo tou ouranou.

i18n.en: and the eternal God will tread upon the earth, upon Mount Sinai, and he will appear from his camp, and he will appear in the power of his might from heaven.

notes.official: The Sinai-theophany echo (*epi to Sina oros*) directly draws on Deut 33:2 + Hab 3:3 + Mic 1:3 + Ex 19. The integration of the cosmic-mountain Sinai-tradition into the 1 Enoch eschatological-judgement framework places the chapter within the broader Northwest-Semitic cosmic-mountain cluster — bidirectional with central entries `har-sinai-horev-the-mountain-of-Elohim-divine-mountain-cross-corpus` and `mountain-as-revelation-site-mt-cross-corpus-har-sinai-mount-sapunu`.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ φοβηθήσονται πάντες, καὶ πιστεύσουσιν οἱ ἐγρήγοροι, καὶ λήμψονται ὕμνον ἐν ἀποκρύφοις τόποις πάντων τῶν ἄκρων τῆς γῆς·
paragraphs.translit: Kai phobēthēsontai pantes, kai pisteusousin hoi egrēgoroi, kai lēmpsontai hymnon en apokryphois topois pantōn tōn akrōn tēs gēs;

i18n.en: And all shall fear, and the Watchers shall believe, and they shall take up a hymn in hidden places throughout all the ends of the earth;

notes.official: *pisteusousin hoi egrēgoroi* 'the Watchers shall believe' is preserved per the Greek + Ge'ez witness despite the ambiguity-of-referent: the referent could be the still-loyal cosmic-Watchers or the fallen 200 introduced at ch 6. Charles 1912 emends to 'they shall fear' on a proposed Aramaic-NHL-not-ʾMN textual hypothesis; the WoH preserves the witness-reading per the standard layered-witness convention.

paragraphs.text: καὶ σεισθήσονται καὶ συντελεσθήσονται τὰ ὑψηλὰ τῶν ὀρέων, καὶ ταπεινωθήσονται καὶ τακήσονται ὡς κηρὸς ἀπὸ προσώπου τοῦ πυρὸς ἐν φλογί.
paragraphs.translit: kai seisthēsontai kai syntelesthēsontai ta hypsēla tōn oreōn, kai tapeinōthēsontai kai takēsontai hōs kēros apo prosōpou tou pyros en phlogi.

i18n.en: and the high mountains shall be shaken and shall be brought low, and shall melt like wax before the flame at the face of the fire.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ ἡ γῆ καταβραχήσεται, καὶ πάντα τὰ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἀπολοῦνται, καὶ κρίσις ἔσται ἐπὶ πάντας.
paragraphs.translit: Kai hē gē katabrachēsetai, kai panta ta epi tēs gēs apolountai, kai krisis estai epi pantas.

i18n.en: And the earth shall be wholly rent asunder, and all that is upon the earth shall perish, and there shall be judgment upon all.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ μετὰ τῶν δικαίων τὴν εἰρήνην ποιήσει, καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς ἐκλεκτοὺς ἔσται συντήρησις καὶ εἰρήνη, καὶ ἐπ' αὐτοὺς γενήσεται ἔλεος, καὶ ἔσονται πάντες τοῦ θεοῦ, καὶ εὐδοκίαν δώσει αὐτοῖς, καὶ πάντας εὐλογήσει καὶ πάντων ἀντιλήμψεται καὶ βοηθήσει ἡμῖν, καὶ φανήσεται αὐτοῖς φῶς, καὶ ποιήσει ἐπ' αὐτοὺς εἰρήνην.
paragraphs.translit: Kai meta tōn dikaiōn tēn eirēnēn poiēsei, kai epi tous eklektous estai syntērēsis kai eirēnē, kai ep' autous genēsetai eleos, kai esontai pantes tou theou, kai eudokian dōsei autois, kai pantas eulogēsei kai pantōn antilēmpsetai kai boēthēsei hēmin, kai phanēsetai autois phōs, kai poiēsei ep' autous eirēnēn.

i18n.en: But with the righteous he will make peace, and upon the elect there shall be preservation and peace, and upon them mercy shall come, and they shall all belong to God, and he shall give them his good pleasure, and he shall bless them all, and he shall help us all, and light shall appear upon them, and he shall make peace with them.

paragraphs.text: ארו אתה עם רבותא די קדישוהי למעבד דין על כלא ולחיבה כל בשרא על כל עבדיהון די חטיו ועל כל קשי מליא די מללו עלוהי חטאין רשיעין
paragraphs.translit: ʾărū ʾāteh ʿim ribbūtāʾ dī qaddīšōhī lě-meʿbad dīn ʿal kollāʾ wě-lě-ḥayyābāh kol bāśrāʾ ʿal kol ʿăbādēhōn dī ḥăṭaw wě-ʿal kol qāšī millayyāʾ dī mallilū ʿălōhī ḥāṭāʾīn rašīʿīn

i18n.en: Behold, he comes with the myriads of his holy ones, to execute judgment upon all, and to destroy all the ungodly, and to convict all flesh of all the works of their ungodliness which they have ungodly committed, and of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.

notes.official: **THE JUDE 14-15 QUOTE SITE — the only OT-pseudepigraphical verse explicitly named-and-quoted as prophecy in the NT.** The Aramaic *ʾārū ʾāteh* 'behold he comes' is preserved in the prophetic-perfect aspect; Jude 14 reads the aorist *ēlthen* 'he came' (a tense-shift extensively discussed in scholarship — see Bauckham 1983 WBC 93-96) and adds the explicit *kyrios* 'the Lord' as subject. The text-critical site is foundational; the WoH preserves the source-tense per the layered-witness convention. See central entry `jude-14-15-quote-1-enoch-1-9-nt-citation-cross-corpus` for the full treatment of the citation-chain Deut 33:2 → 1 En 1:9 → Dan 7:10 → Zech 14:5 → Jude 14-15 → Rev 5:11.
